# certstatus

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/trustyca/server/tasks/certstatus"
```

Package certstatus is the cert\_status task: on every run it marks the Active certificates whose validity ended as Expired and, when ca.retention.expired\_after is set, deletes the certificates of any status that expired longer ago than that, with their revocations. Both run in batches of the lowest IDs \(db.ExpireCertificates and db.DeleteExpiredCertificates\), repeated until a batch is not full, so a run touches every tenant without holding a long transaction; a run is bounded by MaxBatches and the next run continues. The task runs at once when scheduled, then on its schedule.

```
ca:
  retention:
    expired_after: 720h
tasks:
  - name: cert_status
    schedule: "every 1 hour"
```

<a name="Task.Run"></a>
### func \(\*Task\) [Run](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/server/tasks/certstatus/certstatus.go#L60>)

```go
func (t *Task) Run(ctx context.Context) (*Result, error)
```

Run marks the certificates that expired before now and deletes those that expired before now minus the retention, under a new correlation ID, and returns the counts; a DB failure is logged and returned with the counts so far
